quests.title: Deliciousness Knows No Borders

dialogue.section: Check in on how the Wangxiao Cakes are going

dialogue.t: Glaze Lilies for Shenhe, and... I forgot.
Oh, and remember to do your stretches after eating the cake.

dialogue.sit: Ooh! Qiqi and Yaoyao. You're here too, huh?

dialogue.t: We got a letter from Xiangling a couple of days ago. She asked us to pick some Glaze Lilies from Qingce Village, and promised to treat Qiqi and me to cake as a thank-you!
I have received the Glaze Lilies. Please, come over and have some cake.
Qiqi, remember to do your stretches after finishing your cake.
Is everyone already working on the Wangxiao Cakes?
Yep! The secret to making a tasty one is all in the filling! Escoffier came up with a fantastic recipe, so we're just getting ready to mix it now.
The baking process is equally critical. However, the technique is quite specialized and differs greatly from baking normal cakes. So, we'll be relying on Xiangling's expertise for that.
Actually, I've just picked up a thing or two... Let's start with the filling. According to the recipe, we need Glaze Lilies and some top-notch tea leaves...
The tea leaves are here!
It's Lu Xiangxiang!
Miss Shenhe really looked out for me last time at Wanmin Restaurant, so I have to do my part this time.
This should be the finest tea you'll find in all Chenyu Vale. I never thought my family's connections would come in handy one day...
As for the spices Miss Escoffier mentioned earlier, I've already had someone ship them in from Sumeru.
A complete set of alchemical apparatus is also ready to go. It'll extract whatever components you want, no problem!
Everyone from the food street is here!
We can't just let everyone sell nothing but those Five-Nut Wangxiao Cakes, can we? That would defeat the whole point of a food street!
Whoa, this feels just like an Inazuman light novel where the whole crew teams up to take down some big shot!
Well, without further ado, then. Let's start mixing the filling. Thank you all for your help.
The extraction of the Glaze Lily nectar went smoothly.
Hmm, Paimon can already smell that sweet aroma!
Unfortunately, we're still running into issues with tea leaf extraction. They are usually roasted dry and steeped in hot water, so extracting directly from raw leaves isn't working out well.
Raw leaves are essential for what I have in mind. After all, I'm trying to isolate a specific flavor compound, not brew a pot of tea.
In that case, my alchemical setup won't cut it. Miss Escoffier, what about using your centrifuge?
My centrifuge? Even at maximum speed, I'm afraid it still...
Will this work?
Yes, this is exactly the kind of pure tea extract I needed! May I ask what equipment you used?
One of Xianyun's cooking machines, maybe?
I actually used your centrifuge, Miss Escoffier.
But its rotation speed isn't high enough, is it?
Yes, it was a bit slow, so I cranked it by hand.
What!?
Anyway, we now have all our ingredients. Please, leave the filling to me.
Xiangling, do you know how to make Five-Nut Wangxiao Cakes?
Why are you asking about that all of a sudden, Shenhe?
I've never had one before. Smiley Yanxiao said it tastes terrible, but that gentleman claims that it's quite delicious. So, I'm somewhat curious.
Why not just go buy one at the market then? They aren't hard to find.
Hmm... Dad told me that most Five-Nut Wangxiao Cakes on the market nowadays aren't authentic. Chefs don't bother making them properly as pastries anymore.
These days, they're basically treated like decorative filler in Moonchase gift boxes.
Fair enough...
I need to brush up on my baking technique anyway, so while Escoffier is mixing the filling, I might as well practice on these!
Count me in.
{NICKNAME}, Paimon, see you there! Make sure to come taste our joint effort when it's ready!

quests.description: To make Wangxiao Cakes that can win over the Guildmaster and save the food street, everyone pitches in to help...
